_readme: IMM Dashboard configuration.  Edit this file, refresh the browser — nothing to rebuild.
Keys beginning with _ are comments and are ignored.
DATA SOURCE  ->  `dataset`
The page reads the .xlsx directly in the browser; there is no build step.
workbook          path to the workbook, relative to index.html
sheetName         which sheet to read
reportDateColumn  the column driving the Report Month picker
groupColumn       the column driving the Team picker
idColumn          uniquely identifies a row (used for cell selection)
weightColumn      the column used to weight averages in the Total row
Append ?data=<url>&sheet=<name> to the URL to read a different workbook once,
without editing this file.
OPENING VIEW
defaultGroup        team selected on load   (default: the first in `groups`)
defaultReportMonth  month selected on load: "latest" (default), "earliest",
or an explicit date key such as "2026-06-30"
labels              captions above the three pickers:
group / reportMonth / rowsPerPage
COLUMNS  ->  `columns`
Each entry maps one workbook column onto the dashboard, and reads left to right:
column     the column name in the workbook — this supplies the values
analytics  which analytics group it belongs to — this sets the header colour
header     the label shown on the dashboard  ( | starts a new header line )
format     how the value is rendered (below)
Array order is display order.  Delete an entry to drop the column; move an entry
to move the column.  Any column in the workbook may be used, not just these.
FORMATS   text  plain text              musd  USD millions      13,609M
pct1  percent, 1 dp     1.3%  num2  two decimals      1.22
int   whole number       387  tick  green tick when the value is 1
OPTIONAL, per column — omit and a sensible default is derived from `format`:
width      an explicit width in px. Omit it — by default the browser sizes
every column to the values actually on screen, wrapping the text
columns as needed, and users can drag header edges to resize.
flex       true = this column swallows any width the table has spare,
instead of the browser sharing it across all columns.
wrap       text columns wrap by default; set true on a non-text column to
let it wrap too.
align      left | center | right.  Default: first column left, tick centred,
everything else right.
total      sum | avg | wavg | band | share | none — how this column's Total
cell is computed.
computed.  Default: musd sums, other numbers use table.aggregation,
text and tick stay blank.
band       used with total:"band" for a coded column such as an ORR grade.
Each label is translated to its numeric `value` through a mapping
workbook, the weighted mean of those is taken, and the band that
the result falls into supplies the label shown in the Total cell.
{ workbook, sheet, label, value, min, max, exclude: [...] }
Bands are lower-inclusive and scanned in file order, so the first
matching row wins.  Labels in `exclude` carry no weight.
tick stay blank.
share      used with total:"share": the percentage of weight whose value is
one of `values`. Rows with no value are ignored entirely — they
sit in neither the numerator nor the denominator — and only
positive weight counts, as everywhere else.
{ "values": [1, 2], "format": "pct1" }
showWhen   { "<workbook column>": value } — show the cell only when this
matches, e.g. an exclusion reason only for excluded mandates.
ANALYTICS GROUPS  ->  `analytics`
A colour and label per group, so related columns read as one block.
label   shown in the legend under the table
colour  the header band colour
show    false hides every column of this group (can be overridden per team)
`base` is the identity block and is always shown.  Add your own groups freely.
TEAMS  ->  `groups`
The Team picker, in order.  `group` must match a value in dataset.groupColumn.
Every entry may override the blocks above, for that team only:
name       the team's display name, in the picker and as the heading
(default: derived from the data value; `title` also accepted)
columns    the workbook column names this team shows, in display order.
Wins over analytics show/hide.  May only name columns defined above.
analytics  { "esg": false } to hide a group, or
{ "esg": { "colour": "#7A9AA8", "label": "Carbon" } }
An entry with no overrides shows the full `columns` list.
TABLE BEHAVIOUR  ->  `table`
aggregation      wavg = averages weighted by dataset.weightColumn
avg  = plain arithmetic mean
Sets the default for numeric columns; a column's own `total`
still wins.  The Total row always covers every mandate in the
selection, never just the visible page.
monthOrder       "desc" = newest Report Month first (default), "asc" = oldest first
defaultSort      { "column": "<workbook column>", "direction": "asc"|"desc" },
or a list of those for a multi-column opening sort.
pageSize         rows per page on load — a number, or "all"
pageSizeOptions  the choices offered in the Rows per page picker
SORTING  Click a header to sort by that column alone; click again to flip.
Shift-click adds a further sort key (▼ then ▲ then removed); a small
number on the arrow shows its priority.  Sorting uses what the cell
displays, so values hidden by showWhen sort as blank, and blanks
always sort last.

dataset._note: Where the data comes from, and which of its columns drive the page furniture. `workbook` may be relative to index.html, absolute from the site root (/data/...), or a full http(s) URL on a server that allows cross-origin reads. It cannot be an operating-system file path — the browser can only fetch over http. Override it per-visit with ?data=<url>.

labels._note: Captions for the three page controls.
